initial.title: Work, conversations and documents, together.
initial.summary: Version 1.0.0 brings the team's everyday tools into its organization workspace, from assigning work to meetings, conversations and documents.

features.work: Manage tasks and projects with status boards, assignees, due dates, comments and attachments.
features.chat: Talk in your workspace with messages, replies and shared files, keeping the conversation close to the work.
features.meetings: Schedule and join online meetings, with chat, notes and participant tracking in the meeting room.
features.office: Open and work with Docs, Sheets, Slides, PDF, HTML and Markdown through UniWork Office's integrated editors.
features.email: Connect mailboxes to Email Hub to read and send email, and see each account's connection state.
features.ask: Ask UNI to find information and inspect its sources within your access permissions.

improvements.senderImages: Allow images from trusted email senders and manage the list of senders you have approved.
improvements.connectionForms: Mailbox connection forms explain missing information, connection state and the steps to reconnect.
improvements.publicPages: Feature, solution and getting-started pages share their layout, illustrations and navigation.

fixes.mailboxStatus: Account status reflects a disconnected mailbox, and the reconnect notice uses the screen's full width.
fixes.smallDialogs: Form dialogs stay clear of small-screen edges and stack their leading content for easier interaction.

initial.note: Email connections and AI features need the organization's corresponding configuration. Each feature follows the application's access permissions.

v1_1_0.title: Organization data controls, Office and Email Hub updates
v1_1_0.summary: Export and schedule deletion of organization data, explore UniWork Office, follow application releases, and benefit from more reliable Email Hub and VNPay payments.
v1_1_0.note: Organization data export and deletion are for organization owners. The Documents home depends on the organization enabling that feature. Installer buttons appear only for published builds. Email connections and AI features still need the organization's corresponding configuration.

features.ca1d8c53d5022a921403f4dc38949d308db212f2: Organization owners can export business data as a ZIP, schedule deletion after five days and cancel before it runs. Members cannot access the organization while deletion is pending; activity logs and invoices are retained.
features.cadea71f7d7b076297076d43eddb74258e3fbc45: A public changelog at /changelog lists releases by month with new features, improvements and fixes, linked from the main menu and the footer.
features.c568278d78fe988cb444665922b5d161f58f487e: A public UniWork Office page at /office with the six editors, real screenshots and per-OS installer buttons; only published installers are shown. The new Documents home — folders, blank docx, pptx and pdf files, and files from chat, tasks, meetings and Email Hub — is available where the organization enables the Documents feature.

improvements.c71ffdf93b83f81b3b7b7bb3f6530b58373687b6: The landing page shows real captures of the tasks, chat, meetings and document editor screens, in the current language and matching the active light or dark theme.
improvements.cb79dc17d1dbcc8783e58379bbf1ff2edb430d04: Email Hub reuses thread details prefetched within the last 30 seconds, reducing repeated requests as you hover through the list.
improvements.c0b6f78a7b876b8a4c19fcb6d28edaf3c752019d: Email Hub avoids repeated mailbox refreshes for the same event and cancels list requests that are no longer needed.

fixes.c768fddab7062f11312bfa9bfd8d50c7967dac81: VNPay payments are answered with the correct confirmation codes, so a completed payment is no longer treated as unconfirmed and retried.
fixes.ccb2733aec4322d35334e953e23ad6058a014956: Completed VNPay payments are still applied when the checkout link has expired or been replaced, updating the plan and creating the corresponding invoice.
fixes.c5e727e48bbd9c29c40c04b707315db20e6c086f: When VNPay's callback never arrives, an automatic reconciliation pass rechecks the transaction and applies a paid one, or marks it failed when unpaid.
fixes.cbea7437a334f574eb0916083fe1108575338371: Access to Email Hub message bodies consistently follows the user's permissions.
fixes.cd8d9d6735f802da39818b11f34d4484f1768faf: Outgoing email subjects with Vietnamese accents are encoded to the standard and no longer appear as broken characters for recipients.
fixes.c8ca4dcdc17f4c9a17b264412f20895eeaf2e2f4: IMAP now has a time limit when opening the connection and signing in, so an unresponsive mail server reports an error instead of hanging.
fixes.c70e7e68ffc6f459dec9a14f590f82c1146f5d7b: Replying to a message in Sent addresses the original recipients instead of yourself.
fixes.c0109dcd7ecfa62901b357636b12b2171e13e903: Paging through the Snoozed folder no longer skips or repeats messages.
fixes.c4ac1f76ba20df9ffe1062b6ce768a2734c0043c: New-mail notifications stop for people who left the organization, were deactivated, or whose organization is suspended.
fixes.c56a8b72a1d4332176ae1361423a64694da76536: The unread count stays correct after reading or marking messages on list pages that are already loaded.
fixes.c63db9e50bf5f1ab1273abb619174f7ca2ad5bbd: Creating several tasks from an email summary runs as one unit: a failure part-way leaves no stray tasks and the retry still works.
fixes.cd7bf6a7bd4323ce0c5ace8d31f2ac35d75916f6: Outgoing mail keeps its Vietnamese accents and line breaks, even when the HTML body is very long.
fixes.c7edda0f13968681d35798817688ff6abc3312a6: Switching to another message while an AI summary is running no longer shows the previous message's summary and action items on the new one.
fixes.c872812edb8f905bd6add41ed8330ced0b92a52d: A folder's syncing state no longer stays stuck when the filter is changed part-way through.
fixes.c39042c585c161e0307083cc2b6d959e4cc34b52: Disconnecting the open mailbox now moves to the most recent remaining mailbox instead of reselecting the one just removed.
fixes.c4449109cd71c872845a082d5e449db65c860842: Download the UniWork Office installer from the current page without opening and closing a GitHub tab.
fixes.cebd6f5acb86f81fe3d9bbb0b1a2716f57fec8e3: Email Hub sidebar counts refresh after moving, snoozing, marking mail as read or syncing a mailbox.
fixes.cfc9fab018432964c96177b0205d4d17b0a976ae: Text or HTML attachments no longer replace the message body. Messages whose only content is an attachment remain readable.
fixes.cbaebb1de6eb919b01291da742a8707bd9adc46a: Cancelled or failed VNPay transactions are tracked separately, preventing later payments from remaining pending as mistaken duplicates.

v1_2_0.title: Text size in Settings, read-only AI assistant connections and billing fixes
v1_2_0.summary: Pick a text size in Settings for easier reading; connect Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini to read your tasks, meetings and workspaces in UniWork, with a consent page and connection management; plus two billing fixes for invoice numbers and refunds.
v1_2_0.note: Text size is saved per device and does not yet apply to content opened in the Office editors. AI assistant connections are in pilot: the organization must have the feature enabled and an owner must turn on the switch in Settings › AI access. Connections only read data; they never create or change anything in UniWork. The AI access tab is for owners and admins.

features.c2ed272790a5e7f71d9fd77926ad85854dc7df40: Connect Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini to UniWork so an AI assistant can read your tasks, meetings and workspaces from inside the AI app. The connection is read-only, requires your approval on a UniWork consent page, and the assistant sees only the data you are allowed to see in the selected organization; your work list covers today's and tomorrow's meetings.
features.ce480747bc1afa886cce9de6d91949902606cff8: In Settings, the AI apps tab lets you review and revoke each of your own AI assistant connections, while owners and admins also get an AI access tab to turn the feature on or off for the whole organization and revoke any connection. Resetting your password, leaving the organization or deleting your account revokes connections.
features.cefde3523923a9318a79928fb309010f00fe608c: Settings › Preferences now has a Text size option with three levels — Default, Large and Extra large — so text is easier to read on a small screen or when you need bigger type. The level you pick applies as soon as a page opens, is saved per device and follows along in every tab of the same browser; layout, spacing and icons stay unchanged.

fixes.cbb792c946bfaa4df7d8d15502548baa760b1739: Two payments completing within the same second no longer share an invoice number, so the later payment is no longer left pending. The year in the invoice number follows Vietnam time.
fixes.c75c5ddc68ad9e7a61ff80b2a4c0fb4518e068a2: When two refund requests are sent at once for the same payment, only one is processed; the other reports a conflict instead of sending a second refund.

v1_3_0.title: One organization per account, invitations that carry workspaces, comments in Office documents and a batch of billing fixes
v1_3_0.summary: Each account belongs to one active organization; the invitation page previews the invitation and then moves you across in a single step, and an invitation can carry the workspaces you get access to. A sole owner can close an organization, and an account with no organization gets its own Get started page. Office documents in a workspace gained comments, @mentions and a sync bar, and chat files and voice messages open faster. The introduction and UniWork Office pages were rebuilt with a request-a-demo form. Alongside are fixes for refunds, plan quotas and member seats.
v1_3_0.note: The one-organization rule applies to new actions: accounts that already belong to several organizations are left as they are. Closing an organization requires you to be its owner and only active member and to retype the slug to confirm; a closed organization has no restore action yet. An owner who only signs in with Google (no password set) cannot transfer ownership yet. The workspaces attached to an invitation are picked by the organization's admins; someone granted none still joins the organization but sees no content until they are granted some. Comments and sync in Office documents need the organization to have the Office editors enabled; UniWork's AI inside Office and the offline library are still switched off. AI assistant connections remain a read-only pilot and must be enabled for the organization.

features.c317521eedb704bb64491be34bc99bbeab0b53c3: Each account belongs to one active organization, and the server keeps the rule, so several tabs or parallel actions cannot slip past it. When you are invited to another organization, the invitation page previews it and then walks you through leaving your current one, transferring ownership and leaving, or closing it — all in a single step. If the invitation has expired or been revoked, you keep your current organization.
features.c42b1d55cbd34a928e5d29e5e316f0976f06d44b: An owner who is the only active member can close the organization from Settings › Organization after retyping its slug to confirm. The data is kept, pending invitations are revoked and the subscription is cancelled, so a sole owner is no longer stuck inside their own organization.
features.c342307d9f5222db6fe8c9269527923974cb0b37: An account that belongs to no organization is sent to a Get started page to create one or open a pending invitation. In the invitation list and in the chat sidebar, each invitation now opens its own page instead of a join-everything button.
features.ca56ba0bc29ea8ee7ab217cc110efc7d8bd46320: The introduction and UniWork Office pages on the website were rebuilt: tighter navigation, editor imagery that follows light and dark mode, a full-height preview and introduction content consolidated so it is easier to follow. A new Request a demo page sends the request straight to UniWork administrators to handle in the console, and the UniWork Office download section offers exactly the installers the deployment is configured with.
features.c850c91de8bfa831de1dc9a0848d4d6003131d16: Office documents opened in a workspace now have comment threads, @mentions and a comment inbox with notifications, so feedback sits next to the content instead of somewhere else. A sync bar shows whether your save has reached the workspace or is still queued.
features.cd62eba07c6caf11db86430d6ca5500445f398d7: An organization invitation can now carry workspaces: an admin picks them while inviting, and the person is granted access to exactly those workspaces when they accept, including while switching over from another organization. Accepting an invitation lands you straight in the new organization's workspace instead of a create screen. Someone granted no workspace sees a screen that says so, instead of being sent to create one.

improvements.c345cfe2bda271e6ac79e24c3e25fc54aebdc47c: In an AI assistant connection, each tool now shows a readable title — "List workspaces", "My work", "Search UniWork", "Get task", "Get meeting" — instead of its snake_case technical name.
improvements.cc51ea0749ffbe14a51713e253a253999a70cc1c: The invitation, organization switch and organization danger-zone screens read better: long organization names wrap instead of clipping, invitation titles fit a phone screen, and access notices scroll on short windows and offer a way to sign out.
improvements.ccec502219fdaba98b58e7ea89e51e87dc8a5b5f: The interface keeps its layout when you enlarge text and reads better from the keyboard: the top bar and the organization, invitation and onboarding screens fit at 200% text; destructive buttons meet AA contrast in dark mode; the keyboard focus position is always visible; and reduced motion no longer creates transitions nobody declared.
improvements.c84572b6d1daa128be83cc20704a700948b1a5ee: Creating a workspace no longer asks which organization, because each account belongs to just one active organization. The randomly suggested workspace name now follows the interface language you are using.
improvements.c2a60ef2f12c13a9527b65cfd03ca991dff658eb: Chat files, images and voice messages now load straight from storage through signed links instead of going through the server, so they open faster and can use the browser cache; JPEG and PNG images also get a thumbnail. A link that is about to expire or fails to load is refreshed automatically.

fixes.cf32bc6febcbeb9950a6e2cea84edcab99fd535d: When VNPay does not answer or the answer is not properly signed, a refund now stays pending instead of marking the invoice paid again, so a later attempt no longer refunds twice. A signed refusal still returns the invoice to paid and records the revert.
fixes.c41036366d2f1d8ef62593e87cd7d23e1eec31cf: A VNPay invoice that already has money refunded no longer accepts a second automatic refund and must be finished by hand. When the gateway answers status 05 (still processing), the invoice stays pending and the current plan is kept.
fixes.c23708f9f585b8ca6232132d44fd93fb4ff862b0: A hand-paid invoice can only be refunded in full: partial, zero and negative amounts are refused, so a partial refund no longer refunds the whole invoice and drops the plan. When two refunds run at once, the losing one reports a conflict so the list can be reloaded.
fixes.c936c0301e9464116feee322d97ed825abf8f0f7: The accent colour in use now shows correctly in Settings › Preferences even when the browser blocks local storage (private Safari, "block all cookies"), so you can pick the default again without reloading. Every open tab also follows the tab that just changed it.
fixes.c86ea7aff6ce6bfbf839a3ccec1d955b65e55b44: An organization-level invitation no longer makes your whole invitation list disappear.
fixes.ca59d184212dadf80caaca158643727f0bbb428f: Deleting an account no longer fails while scrubbing the member profiles, and a closed organization no longer blocks account deletion either.
fixes.c1e15e45c393de7c54cc985ffd33b51237d63c85: A closed organization no longer leaves its workspaces in your list, its screens send you on instead of reporting the organization as suspended, and a switched-off membership no longer counts as you still belonging to it.
fixes.ca885949c7befc0fd233ccdedb166fb4c80c9e2c: The invitation page accepts an invitation once and no longer hangs on a spinner after you confirm; while the request is being sent, the "Later" button is hidden. When an invitation has stopped working, the page says why.
fixes.cdc3b3b7163e63384dfb3ee0342e499adab5f2e8: An owner who only signs in with Google and has no password is told plainly that an ownership transfer cannot be confirmed, with a pointer to support. The field that picks the new owner explains in place when there is nobody to choose and tells namesakes apart.
fixes.c9396e4f00e2b6b840ef8513a0a29731e1642c88: An invitation into an organization that is being deleted admits nobody and says so, instead of adding someone to an organization that is about to disappear.
fixes.c611c5cf75edea54315ad5f2d49fceb44001ec6c: When accepting an invitation fails, the page now offers a retry that works instead of stranding you; a temporary error (network, 5xx, too many requests) while switching organization no longer loses the choices you already made in the steps. The wizard submits with Enter and says why it stepped back.
fixes.c8f28bfcc0bc6a39cadd9aa0ab2abba490777a90: An out-of-date organization list no longer hides the workspaces you are using or pushes you to the Get started page, and a "suspended" notice no longer flashes up when the organization has actually been closed.
fixes.cb940a6207d0b2d06985666abbc223fcfc45c4fe: When you switch to another organization, the old organization's audit row now records only the reason for the switch and no longer names the new organization.
fixes.c09d515323c7162116cd98e97609e8d4fe52e5b2: A plan with no list price (contact us for a quote) is no longer treated as free: an owner cannot switch to it alone and has to get in touch, so the subscription no longer ages into past due after skipping checkout.
fixes.caca841c7749de9e69bc7d0f2e48e413728d53d1: Re-selecting the plan already in force no longer resets the metering period, so a free plan's quotas can no longer be refilled on demand.
fixes.cc6ea1591b460e9232960b5aba194bea83bb3e16: A plan with no billing period, such as Starter, now meters its accumulating quota by the calendar month in Vietnam time: running out of AI tokens this month starts over next month. Subscriptions with a paid period still meter by that period.
fixes.c98ec32ffe4a7e2deae280fb84e37e31672c5d96: Reactivating a deactivated member now counts one seat, so the last open seat is no longer counted twice and the member really is reactivated.
fixes.cb9550c114f0020415ba41c13d1164a5f5b07c15: Entering the wrong password when confirming again — transferring ownership, accepting an invitation or deleting your account — is now reported as a wrong password right in the dialog, instead of being mistaken for an expired session and resent.
fixes.cdc5e44d123f1e127ce8a18160c91d54a533c9d2: A platform role is no longer enough to change, cancel, resume or check out the plan of an organization the person does not own, and that path no longer skips the paid-plan gates. UniWork staff assign a plan through the admin console, where the reason is recorded.

v1_4_0.title: Workspace info editing, person cards in chat, Vietnamese addresses for public pages and a batch of billing fixes
v1_4_0.summary: A workspace owner or admin can now edit the description, icon, address and task ID prefix from the Settings tab; old links and old task IDs keep working after a change. In chat, clicking a person opens a card from which you can start a private chat or a voice or video call, and person cards and room info list photos, files and links grouped by month. The public pages gained Vietnamese addresses under /vi, a sitemap, three guides under /learn and an About and a Security page, with Changelog moved into the navigation itself. Alongside are fixes for VNPay payments, refunds, plan periods and quotas, and for the UniWork Office installer dialog.
v1_4_0.note: Editing workspace info requires the workspace owner or admin role. An image icon needs the organization to use S3/MinIO storage; on local storage the image cannot be shown yet, the same as avatars. An old slug stays reserved inside the organization and there is no limit yet on how many old slugs a workspace keeps; an old link with an #anchor loses the hash through the redirect. Changing an organization's slug and deleting a workspace remain out of scope. Voice and video calls from a person card use the existing meeting infrastructure. The unfinished UniWork Office capability (sync, AI, collaboration, folders) stays behind feature flags and is not switched on in this version; the UniWork Office installers on the download page are still beta.

features.c4a18daa298613abf3467092d0bcfbcd8f4839d3: A workspace owner or admin can now edit the workspace description (up to 500 characters) and its icon from the Settings tab; the icon is either an emoji or an uploaded image of at most 2 MiB. The description and icon appear on the workspace picker and in the workspace switcher menu, and every edit is recorded in the organization's activity history.
features.cd864391dc331940a6e92d104ba2186e4d46b7d2: A workspace's task ID prefix can now be changed from a dialog in the Settings tab (2–10 uppercase letters or digits, starting with a letter). Old task IDs such as TASK-12 still resolve after the change, and a workspace's current prefix always wins over another workspace's former prefix.
features.c5bf0ba007bf770c45d3747e3e6a65258cee259b: A workspace's address (slug) can now be changed from a dialog in the Settings tab. Links using the old slug redirect to the new address, keeping the path and query string; the old slug stays reserved inside the organization, so no other workspace can take it. System-reserved slugs are refused, and when two admins rename at once the losing one is told about the conflict.
features.c15e833f0d3626c8e82a6072b3e099daf3a348c8: Clicking an avatar or a member's name in chat opens a person card, from which you can start a private chat or a voice or video call. @mentions become real tokens inside a message, attached images stay in the conversation, and the sidebar preview line shows the sender's name instead of an id.
features.c27f12b2c5adda86da0e1287ed454005f871f6e6: The public pages now also have Vietnamese addresses under /vi, with bilingual metadata and structured data, plus a sitemap and a robots file so search engines can read them. Three product guides were added under /learn — start with tasks, Office files and AI, meetings into tasks — along with an About page and a Security page.
features.c850463a8ea4fb49b75f2b4e84e21d4c7cd5885a: Person cards and room info now list the photos, files, links and GIFs of the conversation you have open, as a gallery grouped by month instead of a list of filenames. A camera call is stored and shown as a video call, an oversized file gets a toast naming the limit, and the sidebar typing line uses a real name.

improvements.c6f6466a03e4580423319bba7ea5911ec0abb533: The marketing site now carries Changelog in the shared desktop and mobile navigation, drops the duplicate Learn link, and collapses the header before the Vietnamese labels overflow. The FAQ section keeps its artwork in normal flow so the content stays visible across screen sizes and in both light and dark mode; the mobile hero ribbons show in full with a softer top edge; and the navigation uses the supplied UniWork Office logo.
improvements.c0498b6cb3ac8b79429d2c30c6390f9bb821b98a: Settings › Workspace was tidied up to match the other settings tabs: the icon box uses a muted background with a camera badge and clicking the box itself opens the emoji, upload or remove menu; the Address row shows the /organization/workspace path instead of the full URL while Copy still copies the complete link; the address dialog previews the new path, and the description character counter only appears near the limit.

fixes.ca7aac4a5db9598982ba06ca143aaa8894443bd0: Plan changes in the admin console: when writing the admin record fails, the plan or subscription change is now rolled back in the same transaction instead of leaving the plan changed with no admin record behind it.
fixes.ca9d0a49e10ec263e0183245fd49a9d64048c6a2: A VNPay checkout link now expires together with its payment intent: the link carries the intent's created and expiry time, so VNPay no longer accepts a payment after the intent has expired.
fixes.c952d1e2cbe44c531e44845db65257684260f407: A VNPay payment that already cleared is now applied even when the organization's usage exceeds the new plan's quota, so a charge no longer ends up with no invoice. Checkout still refuses a plan whose quota is too small, and the next quota increase is still blocked.
fixes.cdc6f3392be9e174cc19ab9c2ba15b30ffe2be54: A full refund of an older invoice no longer drops the organization to the default plan when the current period is already paid. The plan only changes when the refunded invoice is the one that set the live period.
fixes.c9e2cc2f55a6485a3ba272b0dbf35ff6a8b45a5d: A plan period is now only one of month, year or none. A free-text period such as yearly used to be stored as typed and priced as a year while the paid period was only a month; catalog writes now refuse it and the admin form picks the period from a list.
fixes.c8028e4cf360302f9b6307889569167b3bc15199: The query and refund calls to VNPay now have a 15-second timeout, so one unanswered request no longer freezes IPN handling and plan lapse until a restart.
fixes.cb8cfd349e9dfcb28e8a55e68d8e7b67b6385c32: Opening a document in the desktop UniWork Office app: the installer dialog no longer appears when the app did open. The deep-link launcher waits 2.5 seconds before calling the app missing and reports a late hand-off for 60 seconds; both the Documents home and Open in UniWork Office close the dialog when the app opens late, and the not-installed copy now says the dialog can be closed, in Vietnamese and English.
fixes.cdbf2cf4b3de7db506d7322e2507477cabfb1f33: The sidebar preview line for the Chung channel now refreshes when a message arrives while you have another conversation open, instead of staying on the previous line.
fixes.c8be2e6dff1e8a2f898595a14e4bc44b641f091d: The admin plan screen now rejects a mistyped price or quota before saving: amounts must be whole numbers, and a bad value disables Save instead of turning 499.000 into 499 or text into an unlimited quota. When the server refuses the write, the form stays on screen with an error.
fixes.c5d891540b40d0b14088aca2f202b66dfeef08ee: A payment is now applied only once: two concurrent applies of the same payment each used to write an invoice, so an organization saw two invoices for one payment. The payment intent is now locked and completed before the subscription change, so the second writer stops.

v1_5_0.title: AI assistants that work with tasks, projects, meetings and documents, a step-by-step connection guide and a large batch of chat fixes
v1_5_0.summary: AI assistants connected over MCP, such as Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini, can now read and write tasks, projects, meetings and documents on behalf of the person who allowed it, and Settings › AI apps has a step-by-step guide for connecting Claude or ChatGPT. A cancelled meeting can be brought back with the Restore button. Chat gets a large batch of fixes to permissions, realtime sync, notifications, threads, search, sending and calls. Alongside are fixes for Email Hub and Documents, and the demos on the marketing site now follow the product's current screens.
v1_5_0.note: An AI assistant can only write when the connection was granted write access, the organization has switched on AI write access and the feature is enabled; the assistant acts on behalf of the person who allowed it, with that person's permissions. Document actions through an assistant follow whether Documents is switched on for the organization; for a page that is too long or has content that cannot round-trip through Markdown, the assistant can only append, not replace the whole page. The step-by-step guide covers Claude and ChatGPT; on a Claude Team or Enterprise plan, the Claude organization owner has to add the connector first.

features.cee5763d0eba8a1097ad8cce142b06b1f2c59795: AI assistants connected to UniWork over MCP can now work with tasks, projects, meetings and documents on behalf of the person who allowed it: see members and tasks, create and edit tasks and add comments; view, create and edit projects; view, schedule, edit, invite people to, cancel and restore meetings; search, read, create and edit documents and comment on them. The assistant has no delete action, every write says how to undo it, and an edit is refused if the item changed since the assistant last read it. The consent page and the AI access switch now name projects and documents as well.
features.c055cc969f60bf8f56d5575ab9107fbc60495e67: A cancelled meeting can now be brought back with the Restore button on its page; the button waits for the request to finish before it can be pressed again.
features.cb8db488814c8f81523fae678d92bf08f62087d6: Settings › AI apps has a Connection guide button that opens a step-by-step dialog for Claude or ChatGPT: pick the assistant, copy the UniWork address, open the assistant's page in a new tab, add UniWork, then sign in and allow access; each step has a drawing that circles exactly what to click. While the dialog is open, UniWork notices the new connection by itself and suggests a first question, with a Check again button if it is not seen yet. Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini logos appear beside the connection sections of AI apps and AI access; on a connected app's row, the logo only shows when that app is verified.

improvements.cfde652d9c629769761cea53dd8c62c816bb5438: When an AI assistant reads a task, it now also gets the 50 most recent comments with their id, author and time, so it can reply to any comment rather than only the ones it wrote itself. Authors are shown by display name, never by email.
improvements.c0ec00567d931c302d0f8cb9ad80d9e788ed44df: The interactive demos on the marketing site are now built from the product's current screens — tasks, projects, chat, Email Hub, meetings, calendar, documents, people and Ask UNI — with sample data, and they play their action sequences automatically again.

fixes.c00ede2f34a81c4247c10125bc13b53f2963e02c: The scope tabs (All, Recent, Shared, Archived) and the file type chips on the Documents home no longer show stray scrollbars, and still scroll sideways on narrow screens.
fixes.cd12a4989a99624ed944cf68d8baa10dce67e56a: When Documents is switched off for an organization, the Documents area of the app is now closed for that organization's members too, in line with public links and AI assistants; other organizations are not affected.
fixes.cb59d1c98dba066ccdad3658a5f8f1c5f2bfdfad: Sending and calling in chat: message, note, post and reminder lengths are counted in characters, so Vietnamese text is no longer called too long early; polls, notes, posts and reminders are no longer duplicated on a flaky network, and sending one in a DM notifies the recipient; the composer clears as soon as you send; @mentions point to the right person even when two people share a name, and @ suggestions in a channel only list its members. A queued message the server refuses for good is dropped with a notice, a retried voice clip no longer arrives twice, GIFs and stickers only load from allowed sources, a new group's name is capped at 80 characters, reminders stop in archived rooms and reminder cards have a delete button. Pressing Call twice rings only once, answering or declining in one tab stops the other tabs ringing, an ongoing call can no longer be taken over by someone else, and a call summary is posted only once.
fixes.c60ce04b243311f6f337b7ccbcdd003e73aeea91: Chat permissions now hold on every action: a person blocked in a DM or barred from sending can no longer post polls, notes, posts or reminders, edit messages, react, pin, vote, call, record or link a thread to a task. A member removed from a group can no longer get back in by creating a new group with the same members; only room moderators can rename a channel and the rename is recorded; a demoted workspace admin also loses admin rights in the default channel; the last admin cannot leave a room that still has members; and room moderation buttons only show where the server allows them. A poll that hides results no longer leaks vote counts before you vote, rejoining a public channel you left no longer fails, a colleague from another workspace can join DM and group calls, and opening a DM with a deactivated colleague no longer locks your own screen.
fixes.c7458c4c4acf123f2d4392446cadadca8c5b24a7: Chat threads and search: a long thread now shows its older replies too; opening a thread no longer follows it, and the thread bar has a Follow / Unfollow button; deleting a reply updates the root's reply count; a reply sent while offline stays in its thread; jumping to a message no longer mixes thread replies into the main timeline, and Back to newest returns to the end of the room and marks it read; Summarize in a thread covers its unread replies. Searching without Vietnamese marks still finds messages (hop finds Họp), and the channel directory filters correctly even when you type _ or %. Editing or deleting a message in a thread linked to a task carries over to the task comment and the other way round, and deleting a task removes its chat links.
fixes.c3b5dbfd16c9e9698479dc08ae75fea87678df71: Chat realtime sync and notifications are steadier: the sidebar reloads at a bounded rate and channels send a member count instead of the whole member list, so a busy channel no longer slows everyone down; a channel switched to private stops reaching outsiders; renamed, archived or new channels and members removed from a room update the sidebar straight away; and after a connection drop the open room, task links and recording state are loaded again. Reading a chat closes its notification so DM pushes resume, a merged notification row opens the newest message, muting a room applies on every device, and the sidebar preview and unread counts stay right when an older message changes or a thread reply lands in the default channel. Closing one of your tabs no longer shows you as offline to others.
fixes.c6764d566d5eb554969fc4b987ae3e8e3a66708a: Email Hub: the Starred folder now pulls the mail you starred in your mailbox (Gmail included), Spam syncs in the background, Trash and Spam sync as soon as you open them, and moving mail to another folder syncs the target folder first. When writing, a long draft scrolls and pasted images become attachments; the empty Scheduled and Snoozed folders explain that they only hold mail scheduled or snoozed in UniWork.
fixes.cd363ca48e750a9dfe29aa3efbef9a9c4045c48d: Email Hub opens mail faster and more reliably: it shows the snippet while the body loads, retries a failed body load by itself, preloads the neighbouring messages, and only marks mail read once the body has loaded.
fixes.c13087a29b3cb2ad63dc7a132870cbb4b3018c83: In Documents, going to the source of a file that came from chat now opens the right room and highlights the message that carries the file, instead of just opening Chat.
fixes.c8d3b953959e51a40d91645de8e49a89fa4e7a9a: Chat notifications are more reliable: editing a message to add an @mention notifies the newly mentioned people, a missed call in a DM notifies the recipient, followers of a thread in a public channel get its replies even before joining the channel, and notifications are retried after a temporary failure instead of being lost. Editing a message keeps its priority and other message data, and resending a message that was deleted now gets a clear error instead of a server error.

v1_5_1.title: Product menu opens each feature page, and demos use new sample data
v1_5_1.summary: A patch for the marketing site: each entry in the Product menu opens that feature's own page, the Watch demo button on a feature page opens the demo right there, and the demos use a new sample workspace. The Calendar demo follows the current Calendar screen.
v1_5_1.note: This patch only changes the marketing site; the UniWork app itself is unchanged.

improvements.c31a87b6e474f69e33cd44093e483d24dfe1a4f3: The demos on the marketing site use a new sample workspace, members and tasks in both Vietnamese and English. The Calendar demo has the same search box as the current Calendar screen and opens at 08:00.

fixes.cb13d6b99001d8be5b4c49a8fe32dde8ad182f59: On the marketing site, each entry in the Product menu now opens that feature's own page, and the Watch demo button on a feature page opens the demo right there. The illustration at the end of the home page uses the product's current interface.

v1_6_0.title: A new Chat, edit locks and Trash in Documents, and task status and label settings
v1_6_0.summary: Chat on the web has a new design and adds message forwarding, voice message transcripts and playback speed, link previews, delivered ticks, and separate Messages and workspace channels. Documents gains edit locks while someone is editing, a Trash, My Folder, sharing with a whole workspace and uploading large files in parts, plus tools for managing access: access requests, sharing with several people at once, ownership transfer and an access report. Workspace settings add Task statuses and Labels tabs, and task cards can show labels. Ask UNI finds sources better and keeps the topic across follow-up questions. Creating tasks from a meeting's AI summary is fixed so tasks are created correctly, completely and only once.
v1_6_0.note: The access report only covers documents you administer. Tasks from a meeting summary are created only after the host confirms them, and AI summaries follow the organization's current plan. Only workspace owners and admins can change statuses and labels. Voice message transcripts require AI to be turned on for your organization and count toward the AI quota.

features.cca3275dc8b0fb0b2296db9529abe6546bec9b1f: Share a document with several people at once instead of adding them one by one.
features.c637118da6a7728102ae5a117c56babe0e609d88: Administrators get a document access report showing who has access to the documents they administer.
features.c896171fc59d1de0c535d2cd0febe6ca41e7738b: Document ownership can now be transferred to another member.
features.ca9583ec607f78bedf7a94c006620f1ee5d7c108: When a member opens a document they have no access to, they can request access. The document's managers get a notification and can approve or decline the request.
features.c9fccc520a0414af5b9002b19e7d118fb86b13f5: Chat adds: forwarding a message to up to 10 rooms at once, showing the original sender's name (administrators can turn this off in group, channel or workspace room settings; when off, only room moderators can forward); transcripts for voice messages when your organization has AI turned on, created only on request and counted once toward the AI quota; voice playback at 1×, 1.5× or 2×; preview cards for links in messages; a delivered tick alongside sent and seen; the faces of people who replied on thread labels; page count and first page for PDF files; and a progress bar with a Cancel button when downloading files. The action bar of the first message under the room header can now be clicked.
features.c356e8ffc953347979413a330e69c7710e6aa986: Documents: while someone is editing, the document is locked for editing; others can request to edit or take over, and the people involved are notified. The Documents library adds a Trash with per-item restore and notifications when a document is moved to or restored from the Trash; filters by type and by access; a "Shared by me" view; and a private "My Folder" that is the default save location and stays hidden from others in search. Version history shows who created each version. Documents can be shared with a whole workspace. Large files upload in parts and can resume after an interruption, within one size limit for all document types, and saving unchanged content no longer creates a new version. "Pages" is renamed UniNote. This release also fixes the star button, and go-to-source links from Chat now open the right room.
features.c9c8a3b74619de2d85f0ec70d387853fd1affd58: Settings › Workspace adds Task statuses and Labels tabs. Workspace owners and admins can create, edit, archive and drag to reorder statuses within four groups (Not started, Started, Completed, Closed) and pick a color and icon, and can create, edit and delete labels, with the number of tasks using each one. Other members see both tabs read-only and can still add and remove labels on tasks as before. The Blocked status now belongs to the Started group.

improvements.ccccea0fc160226064e08619e8012695125b2dc9: The Documents library has new columns showing each document's access.
improvements.c22ea091760670c281c9996cbb45c136910655dd: Chat on the web has a new design. The room list is split into tabs with counts and shows missed calls, voice message length and seen ticks. An info panel on the right shows the description, tasks from the conversation, photos, files, links, voice messages and members. You can reply to and edit messages right in the composer, threads open in the right panel, messages that fail to send are kept with a "Retry" button, and photos sent together are grouped into an album. Groups and channels show who has seen each message, and groups can have a photo and a description. This release also fixes several issues: opening a link to a room no longer marks the workspace room as read, rooms with images open at the latest message, links and jumps to a specific message are no longer pulled to the bottom, the emoji picker follows light/dark mode, and single-choice polls no longer show as "multiple choice".
improvements.c961ef62c74f6af3ca50adeb2153fd4c2b1b2c6b: Ask UNI finds sources better: searches without Vietnamese diacritics still match, searches with diacritics match them exactly, tasks can be found by their ID such as ORI-12, and documents you can view are searched too. Follow-up questions such as "Who is working on that?" keep the previous question's topic. When no source is found, the notice appears in your language. The Ask UNI panel's width is fixed; typing with an input method (IME) no longer sends early on Enter, switching workspace no longer mixes conversations, and the panel no longer flickers when sending.
improvements.ce23e2771c66928dccf84fbd9cda331f37404b68: Workspace owners and admins can edit the name, description, color and icon of built-in statuses (their group stays the same); edited names appear in Settings, the status picker, and column and group headings in board, list, swimlane and table views. Board cards and list rows show up to two labels plus "+n" when Labels is turned on in the Display menu.
improvements.c65c909bed73758a152f42b9a47db1808fc92ac0: Chat separates Messages (direct and group chats, shared across the organization) from workspace channels: the chat page shows one at a time, with a "Messages | Channels" switcher on the web, so direct and group chats no longer repeat in every workspace's list. New-message notifications show a banner with a preview line for every room you have not muted, group messages included; while the app is open, only the room you are viewing stays silent.

fixes.c15cfad8411e546621d6df9d7b6503a128bac61c: If the Share dialog fails to load the member list, you can retry right in the dialog.
fixes.cdefc46087dd47e7b2e383fa681b092a855e46e0: Creating tasks from a meeting's AI summary: tasks are created exactly as the host confirmed, once and as a whole batch; an item already turned into a task, or an outdated summary, no longer creates tasks again. The review dialog lets you adjust the assignee, due date, priority and project; assignee suggestions match whole words and are left empty when names are ambiguous, and due dates read phrases like "next Tuesday" correctly and reject dates in the past. Created items link to their task, each error explains what to do, and a meeting runs only one summary at a time.
fixes.c9138dd10cf4ec713e49bc35b9b7bfdd181d24ab: Chat and notifications: the mention count inside a room now matches the count shown in the room list, and notification digest emails only include items from workspaces and chat rooms you can still access.

v1_7_0.title: A new conversation view, message search across rooms and pins in Chat; a formatting toolbar in UniNote
v1_7_0.summary: Chat has a new bubble-style conversation view, message search across every room you belong to, up to 10 pinned messages per room, a right-click actions menu, a call strip while a call is minimised and a mute button on a person's profile card; rooms you have muted no longer ring for calls. UniNote gets a formatting toolbar and a shortcuts panel, .txt files open in the editor, and the Documents library and share dialog are tidier and clearer.
v1_7_0.note: Message search only covers rooms you are a member of. When a room already has 10 pinned messages, an older pin must be removed to pin a new one.

features.cba68789f9922643c1e51b57f8f6810d23507e22: Search messages across every chat room you belong to, right from the conversation list; results show a snippet with the matching words highlighted, and clicking one takes you to that message. The conversation list is also more compact and marks unsent messages with "Draft:".
features.c5db3ec268ccf43bf9b336db1fa571d76fd9d69e: When you minimise a call, a strip at the top of the chat shows that the call is still in progress.

improvements.cd57d97c03c0b3e0b03d598d69392631b8237d34: Calls: rooms you have muted no longer ring for incoming calls, and calls in channels play no ringtone.
improvements.cdd0a583f74e20745388dd74aefeba55db328c1f: Pinning in Chat: each room can pin up to 10 messages, with the newest pin shown first; when the limit is reached, you are asked whether to replace the oldest pin. Right-clicking a message opens an actions menu with a row of reactions, and this menu shows who has seen your message.
improvements.caac706f2ad896b32b0fcbae89dd466d42909629: The Chat conversation view is redesigned: messages appear as bubbles and direct chats no longer show avatars; hovering a message shows a single quick heart button, while keyboard focus opens the full action bar; the reply or edit bar sits right above the composer, and Esc cancels a reply. Animations turn off when reduce motion is on.
improvements.c5444b681da437e1adf9ed8893851a17fa86891b: The message actions menu stays clickable in long conversations, opens downward when there is no room above and closes when you scroll. A person's profile card has a button to mute or unmute notifications for the current conversation.
improvements.c0424076a5c7443babfeeb091d77e84d18446fc2: Documents and UniNote: the UniNote editor has a formatting toolbar, a first-use tip and a shortcuts help panel; the "/" menu and Markdown shortcuts also work on lines after a line break. .txt files open in the editor in plain text mode. The first-save dialog lets you pick a folder, Office documents have a Print entry, and the share dialog is clearer and consistently says "Private". "My Folder" appears once in the folder tree, "Shared by me" lists only the topmost shared item, the comment box shows @Name when you mention someone, and discussion threads have a new design.
improvements.c5f3b1fb9b72701e4053bd93ccc2f4e2cc053d75: The Documents library gets several refinements: a share badge for people with comment access, long folder names are shortened, opening a document's link opens the folder that contains it, "Share with workspace" is separate from Folder, and the empty state fits better when files are inside folders.

v1_8_0.title: Faster document sharing, Chat wallpapers and quick reactions, and browser system notifications
v1_8_0.summary: The Documents list lets you share from each row, select several documents to share or download as a zip, sort and filter better, and comes with a new access report. Chat gets a shared wallpaper per room, quick reactions, CSV and Markdown file sharing, a smoother conversation when sending in a row or reading history, notices when someone votes, and polls you can pin or add options to. The browser can show system notifications for messages, meeting reminders and calls. Ask UNI uses the status labels shown on screen, a Privacy Policy page is available at /privacy, document comments let you view the version that holds the commented passage, and My Tasks loads every task column by column.
v1_8_0.note: Muting a room only silences ringing for group and channel calls; calls in direct chats still ring. Notices after the browser tab is closed are available only when the server has push notifications configured, and incoming calls are announced only while UniWork is open.

features.c65f3f63676c33fb8ffa3973af36f699c95167a0: When someone votes in a Chat poll, a small notice at the end of the conversation shows who joined which poll, with a View button that takes you to that poll; the original poll card stays where it is and updates its vote counts.
features.c12721dfeb1a1ec3d59d6255b2ae6bb92fdb15fa: A public Privacy Policy page at /privacy, in Vietnamese and English: the data collected, device permissions, AI, the providers that process data, retention, how to delete an account or organization, and your rights under Decree 13/2023. The footer links to the page together with the support email; the account deletion section has its own link at /privacy#delete-account, and the page's tables stack neatly on phones.
features.ce13f89971f752f4cd450ac462dc44dfdeddfde3: Documents: share and manage access straight from a row in the list; select several documents to share them at once or download them as one zip file (up to 100 documents); sort from the column headers, with names in Vietnamese order, and filter by editor and time; Recent shows the latest activity. The access report is redesigned with a summary, a by-person table, access revoking and export. .txt files always open and can be created with Plain text. Folders outside My Folder are visible to the whole workspace and members can create content inside them, while the documents in them stay private until shared. Document change notices are grouped per document, with the list opening from the notification bell and Home. In Chat, send an existing document as a link with Attach from Documents; access granted through Chat is revoked when the recipient leaves the room. UniNote keyboard shortcuts follow Word for the web, and Ctrl/Cmd+S saves right away.
features.c866159078a243ad74975a6cc520072a720e7332: Chat wallpapers: pick a colour, a built-in pattern or your own image (under about 900 KB) for each conversation from the settings of a direct chat, group or channel. Everyone in the room sees the same wallpaper; in a direct chat both people can change it, while in groups and channels only room admins can.
features.c746cbd4249c4eb107c7fbf9afc44a378382b04d: Browser system notifications: UniWork invites you to turn on notifications to get new messages, meeting reminders and incoming calls outside the window while the app is open, with a test button in Settings › Notifications. Getting notices after the tab is closed requires the server to have push notifications configured and does not apply to incoming calls.

improvements.c831c0910ee27de6a508932005979a31836ebc7b: Document comments: when the commented passage is no longer in the current version, the comment says so and lets you open the version that still contains it read-only, then return to the current one. Marking a comment as resolved notifies its author and the document's owners. Opening a notice about a document you can no longer access shows "no access", and a deleted document shows "deleted"; opening an Office document from a comment that no longer exists still opens the document. In Chat, the share-as-document action and the document card on your own messages are easier to read.
improvements.c70c6965823b95e78087da436b7f1f37d2d6220a: Calls in Chat: muting a room silences ringing only for group and channel calls; calls in direct chats still ring. The room list shows the latest poll vote in the preview line.
improvements.c0f496005d5c93547c653dd036fbe607549ea163: Chat polls: a poll created with the pin option is pinned to the top of the room; when a poll allows adding options and has not expired, members can add new options themselves. The list of voters loads only when you open the voters dialog.
improvements.cd27f9296f7bf1434f4e6d55e221088886f3e8ee: The Chat conversation and message composer now use the full window width instead of being held to a narrow centre column.
improvements.c4892d5b67cc9442004c304b002790e52ab95603: In Chat, hovering the heart action on a message shows a column of quick reactions so you can react with one click.
improvements.c9dc4cbdc366fe6b777ab57010b575160c9c6b1d: The UniOffice guide on the website adds a walkthrough for reviewing a DOCX document with AI and a troubleshooting section for files that will not open, save or use AI; the UniOffice page links straight to the guide.
improvements.c29525a88ddb8c9b912b044b0a8bcd3b7f613a7d: Chat now lets you send CSV and Markdown files (.csv, .md) alongside images, PDFs, plain text, Word and Excel files.
improvements.c886caab063dd9967f8098c1a6a9121bcab357ea: Ask UNI now receives task, project and meeting statuses as the labels shown on screen (such as To do), so Vietnamese answers use those labels instead of raw codes like todo or planned; custom workspace statuses use the names you gave them.
improvements.cf9cdc3c6868c4a578845c50fa159696378144c2: The Chat conversation is smoother: a message you send appears right away, and sending several in a row no longer makes the view jump; when you read history and load older messages, your reading position stays put; every message bubble, including incoming ones in a run of messages, shows its time.

fixes.c00442921bb805d62e2acd4ca821b9961afa5d2b: On the website, app icons and names in the mobile menu line up properly again.
fixes.c012ad1c97b8e1fe0bdb6476e3db9fda8e288eb7: Standalone photos in Chat no longer have a coloured frame around them; photos with a quote keep a thin border, and photo albums lose their extra padding.
fixes.c95903b75040d1eeb842587f70e0f88954ca44f9: Email Hub: starred Gmail messages sync more accurately, including on a full account refresh; messages you move to Trash or Spam from another email app show up in the right folder without waiting or opening those folders.
fixes.cd4ace5438fda5aaa1dd4d0a9e2b1f3cf05d4f23: After signing in, UniWork only sends you to a destination page inside UniWork; a destination containing spaces, control characters or a backslash takes you to the default page instead.
fixes.c97190ef880cb0becddefbac601fc868bfd3fe38: UniChat for desktop on Windows now offers to turn on notifications and asks for permission, instead of showing only a red dot on the taskbar; if the test notice does not appear, turn on UniChat in Windows Settings › System › Notifications.
fixes.cf26deea1665f84bf6164e04ca55f13836317037: The board and table in My Tasks now load tasks column by column like the workspace task page, instead of stopping at the first 50 tasks.
fixes.cbd62328c1ab8482fcaec239e846678bdd723c6d: The sign-in sessions list in security settings shows one row per session instead of repeating the same session.
fixes.c59253aa471b10dfba393387e89f84323c95f659: On the website, the task demos on phones show a grouped list so task details fit the screen instead of being cut off sideways.
fixes.cff18730616d298ece7119b09d7576642209166c: Chat fixes: when someone replies to your thread, the thread shows as unread until you open it, and its read state no longer moves back; follow-up reminder notices are marked read when you complete or delete the reminder; @ suggestions show up to 20 people, and typing more letters narrows them; a task can be linked to only one thread; day labels in the room list follow the message's day correctly.

v1_9_0.title: Meeting action items, clearer folder upload and sturdier Chat calls
v1_9_0.summary: Meeting pages have an action items list for handing out work after a meeting and carrying unfinished work over to the next one. Folder upload in Documents accepts older-format Office files and warns before uploading when the browser cannot read a file. Ask UNI shows statuses more cleanly, and Chat calls carry on when the server restarts.
v1_9_0.note: If folder upload warns that the browser cannot read a file, open UniWork Office to upload that folder, or choose to upload the remaining files.

features.c42a543eee4c12d2612f4619acd5b0a02bac821e: Meeting action items: on the meeting page, the secretary can review, assign, skip, restore or add items, then turn the whole batch into tasks. Each assignee gets one notification for the batch, each task shows which meeting it came from, and unfinished work carries over to the next meeting. The meeting page is also reorganized by meeting stage; inviting someone who is waiting to join now lets them in at once, and quick meetings use the creator's time zone instead of UTC.

improvements.c5a748062298e681c7f210d9fe482b678f356dad: Chat calls are now saved on the server: if the server restarts mid-call, a call that is ringing or in progress can still be answered, joined and ended as usual, and the call log message still records the right outcome.
improvements.c9f738cbd0e4831e41a30592743d62b28efe410b: Folder upload in Documents: if the browser cannot read some files, usually because their Windows path is too long, UniWork warns you before uploading, lists those files and lets you open UniWork Office to upload the folder or upload the remaining files. A long file name in the upload dialog no longer pushes the buttons outside the dialog.

fixes.cd8bb3a1eea6ee3af8238a78e16cb906057a38ca: Folder upload in Documents: valid Word, Excel and PowerPoint files in the older formats (.doc, .xls, .ppt) are no longer reported as having the wrong format, and a file the browser cannot read no longer shows a dropped connection followed by useless retries.
fixes.cc1def6d37a298966b36f85f4dbaaac952240b6a: Ask UNI answers show only the status name you see on screen, without an internal status code in brackets such as "To do (todo)". Asking for tasks by a status name your team created, such as "Waiting for QA", also finds the right tasks.
fixes.cc8f02e00827170d00e7198c4e86696d603f9e45: Chat call recording: when two people start recording the same call at the same time, the call now gets one recording instead of two duplicates.

v1_10_0.title: Document ownership transfer, a panel layout and better-synced scheduled email
v1_10_0.summary: Documents lets you transfer ownership of one document or all of a member's documents, filter by several types at once, and move items to the trash without being blocked by sub-pages or files you cannot manage. On desktop, the top bar, sidebar, main page and Ask UNI are split into separate panels. Email Hub updates the Scheduled folder right away after you schedule an email.
v1_10_0.note: The panel layout applies on wide screens; phones, tablets and UniChat keep the previous layout.

features.c237fc6d47c92be3f0abdf2c6d40c893d6acfc3a: Documents: transfer ownership of one document to someone else, or move all of a member's documents to another member at once; the new owner gets a notification. The Type filter accepts several types at once, shown as chips you can remove one by one. When you move a page, file or folder to the trash, sub-pages and files you cannot manage are moved to the workspace root instead of blocking the whole action; a sub-folder you cannot view or manage still blocks it. The UniWork Office install page adds installing from the apt repository and a one-command install next to the .deb file, and the Office source viewer has a maximize button.

improvements.ca6714faf79e3eb2e5b258b1f5cb96cfdc1f7cd9: The desktop layout is split into panels: a top bar runs across the whole app with the organization and workspace switcher, search, Ask UNI, notifications, create and your account; the sidebar is its own panel you can collapse (⌘B still works); the main page and Ask UNI sit side by side as two panels you can drag to resize. The Create task button in the top bar uses a briefcase-with-plus icon, and all icons have the same stroke weight at every size.

fixes.c9f7c3046356c3008e37eaa2c11b3f3f8f3a2354: Email Hub: after you schedule an email, the open mailbox switches to the account that sends it, the Scheduled folder refreshes when you open it, and the list and the sidebar count update right away.

guide.other: Using another assistant, such as Gemini CLI or Claude Code? Add the address on the AI apps page to it as an MCP server.
guide.copyBody: Press the copy button. You will paste this address into {{client}} in the next step.
guide.openClaude: Open Claude in your browser or the Claude desktop app, go to Customize, then the Connectors tab.
guide.openChatgpt: Open the ChatGPT Plugins page in your browser. Press Add at the top right, then choose Add custom MCP server.
guide.openNote: It opens in a new tab. Keep this UniWork page to carry on.
guide.addClaude: Press + Add at the top right and choose Add custom connector. Type UniWork as the name, paste the address you copied as the MCP server URL, then press Continue and follow it through until it is added.
guide.addChatgpt: Type UniWork under Name. Under Connection, keep Server URL and paste the address you copied. Leave Authentication on OAuth. Tick I understand and want to continue, then press Create as a plugin.
guide.allowTitle: Sign in to UniWork and allow
guide.allowBody: {{client}} opens a UniWork page. Sign in if asked, pick your organization, then press Allow. To let {{client}} create and edit work for you, tick Allow create and edit before you press it.
guide.waiting: Waiting for the connection. This page moves to the last step once {{client}} is connected.
guide.notYet: No new connection yet. Check that you pressed Allow on the UniWork page {{client}} opened.
guide.doneBody: {{client}} can now read your tasks, meetings and documents in UniWork.
guide.tryIt: Try asking {{client}}: "What do I have on this week?"
guide.useClaude: In each conversation, press + › Connectors and turn on UniWork.
guide.useChatgpt: Start a new conversation, type @ and choose UniWork.
guide.mobileClaude: The Claude phone app can use this connection too.

guide.title: How to get a Gmail app password
guide.description: Follow these steps in your Google Account. You only need to do this once per mailbox.
guide.step1_body: App passwords require 2-Step Verification on your Google Account. Open Security settings and enable it if it is off.
guide.step2_body: In Google Account, go to Security, then under "How you sign in to Google" choose App passwords. You may need to sign in again.
guide.step3_title: Create an app password for UniWork
guide.step3_body: Select Mail as the app, choose Other (Custom name), enter "UniWork", then click Generate.
guide.step4_body: Google shows a 16-character password (often in four groups). Copy all of it and paste it into the App Password field in the connect form — not your regular Gmail password.
guide.footer: Use this app password only for UniWork. You can revoke it anytime in Google Account.

faq.title: What your team will ask
faq.q1: How is this different from the tools we already use?
faq.a1: UniWork brings tasks, online meetings, chat and email into one workspace. Ask UNI helps read data within granted access. Feature availability and service connection requirements are noted in each section.
faq.q2: Can AI change my work on its own?
faq.a2: Ask UNI is currently read-only. For tasks the AI suggests from a meeting, the host reviews the owner, due date and project, then confirms before creation. An autonomous agent runtime is still on the roadmap; undo support depends on the action, not every change.
faq.a3: Access is managed at organization and workspace level. Membership and role determine what you can access; Ask UNI only reads within granted permissions.
faq.a4: Data location depends on the deployment and connected services. Confirm storage regions, backups and AI processing locations with your operator before uploading organizational data.
faq.q5: Can we use our own AI model?
faq.a5: Anthropic, OpenAI or Ollama can be configured. With Ollama, processing location depends on the server you configure. Check recording, transcription and storage services too if you need the entire data flow to stay internal.
faq.q6: Which languages does the product ship in?
faq.a6: The interface is available in Vietnamese and English. Additional languages are on the roadmap.
faq.a7: UniWork is in pre-launch. This page separates current capabilities from the roadmap; some features need configuration or a connected service before use.
faq.a8: Starter is free with clear limits; Team is 499,000 VND/month and Business is 1,499,000 VND/month. Prices and quotas match the in-app catalog — see the public pricing page or Settings › Plan after sign-up.
faq.q9: Can it run on our own infrastructure?
faq.a9: Not today. An on-premise install through Docker Compose or Helm is on the roadmap, along with any OIDC provider, MinIO storage and models running in house.
faq.a10: Yes. The server builds its OpenAPI specification at start-up from the routing table itself, so the specification cannot drift from the code. HMAC-signed webhooks and a TypeScript SDK are on the roadmap.

product.s1Desc: The video room lives inside the workspace, so the meeting has an owner and stays with the board instead of drifting into a link.

product.a1: For the status board, comments and change history, yes. There are no burndown charts or point estimates yet, so if your team lives on those, wait.
product.q2: Do agents create tasks on their own?
product.a2: An agent proposes and a person confirms before anything is written. There is no path for an agent to write straight to the board.
product.q3: Do meeting notes turn into tasks automatically?
product.a3: Not yet. Meetings and the board share a workspace and a permission set today, but a person still creates the task.

operations.metaDesc: Organization and workspace roles, action history and permission-aware Ask UNI.
operations.title: Clear assignments. A trace you can find.
operations.sub: Keep responsibilities, access scope and history beside the work so the team can coordinate and review when needed.
operations.s1Desc: Membership comes in two tiers, per organization and per workspace, so someone can reach their own work without seeing the rest.
operations.s2Desc: The log only ever grows. A wrong entry is answered with another entry, and nobody can delete the history.
operations.s3Desc: Ask UNI reads within authorized access and answers with sources. People verify and decide; autonomous execution remains a direction.
operations.w1: Two permission tiers, and agents inherit exactly those two.
operations.w2: A deactivated member loses access at both tiers but keeps everything they created.
operations.w3: Every request carries one correlation id through the log and the system trace.
operations.a1: The log is kept whole and retention never deletes from it. Export runs through the admin tooling today; there is no button in the interface yet.
operations.q2: What happens to someone's data when they leave?
operations.a2: Deactivating a member closes both gates but keeps everything they ever created: tasks, comments, history. Nothing removes a person from the record.
operations.q3: Is there workflow automation like a workflow engine?
operations.a3: A complete workflow engine is not available. Ask UNI is read-only; agent and automation foundations should be distinguished from autonomous execution.

why.title: The big problems with today's platforms
why.sub: More tools. More features. And the work is still fragmented.
why.lead: Understanding where the leading platforms stop is how we can see the opening for a better generation of solutions.
why.disclaimer: The assessments below are based on each platform's public documentation at the time of writing. All four ship new features constantly, so verify for yourself before deciding.
why.gapSub: From fragmented work to an organisation that actually performs.
why.gapBody: UniWork does not just hand you tools. It understands the context of the work and connects people, knowledge, data and AI to produce real results.
why.pillar1Desc: Email, meetings, projects, tasks, decisions and documents in one space, under one set of permissions.
why.pillar2Desc: The assistant reads organisational data under the asker's own permissions, instead of guessing from a pasted excerpt.
why.pillar3Title: Work Products are the real output
why.pillar3Desc: Create, edit, approve, analyse and present right where the work that produced them lives.
why.pillar4Desc: Cloud, private cloud, on-premise and BYOK, built for companies and public bodies in Vietnam.

ms365.name: Microsoft 365
ms365.desc: A complete office suite trusted by hundreds of millions of people.
ms365.i1Desc: Separate applications such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and Teams rarely add up to one coherent experience.
ms365.i2Desc: Total cost of ownership is high, especially for small and mid-sized companies.
ms365.i3Desc: Mostly cloud-first, with on-premise options narrowing over time.
ms365.i4Desc: Copilot is strong, but it works inside one application at a time and does not grasp the organisation's processes or goals.
ms365.i5Desc: Difficult to adapt to an industry's specifics or a company's own process.
ms365.summary: Very strong on tooling, but the work stays fragmented and the operational load is heavy.

notion.name: Notion
notion.desc: A flexible workspace that combines documents, databases and AI.
notion.i1Desc: Good for notes and information, weaker on process, approvals and governance across departments.
notion.i2Desc: DOCX, XLSX and PPTX support is limited, and is not what the platform is for.
notion.i3Title: Thin on complex projects and tasks
notion.i3Desc: Tasks and projects stay basic, and struggle with operations at scale.
notion.i4Desc: You need several outside tools to connect email, calendar, meetings and process.
notion.i5Desc: It understands the content but never really reaches the full context of the work or the operational data.
notion.summary: Excellent for knowledge and collaboration, but not enough to run a complex organisation.

clickup.name: ClickUp
clickup.desc: A powerful work management platform with ambitions to be the everything app.
clickup.i1Desc: A crowded interface, an easily overwhelmed user, and a steep learning curve.
clickup.i2Desc: Several ways to do the same thing make it hard for a team to settle on one.
clickup.i3Desc: Docs are fine at a basic level but weak for long documents and standard files.
clickup.i4Title: Not tuned for large or specialised organisations
clickup.i4Desc: Customisation and multi-organisation governance remain limited.
clickup.i5Title: AI has improved but does not differentiate
clickup.i5Desc: ClickUp Brain is useful, but it has not produced a clear edge in understanding an organisation or executing multi-step work.
clickup.summary: Strong on work management, but prone to feature overload and short on depth for larger companies.

coda.name: Coda
coda.desc: Documents, data tables, automation and AI combined in one flexible space.
coda.i1Desc: Powerful as it is, the document-table structure gets hard to manage as things grow.
coda.i2Title: Not a complete answer for a company
coda.i2Desc: Focused on documents and data, without full coverage of email, meetings, project management and operations.
coda.i3Desc: DOCX, XLSX and PPTX support is limited, and is not the focus.
coda.i4Desc: Compared with Microsoft, the partner ecosystem and third-party integrations are thin.
coda.i5Title: Strong AI in a narrow range
coda.i5Desc: The AI helps with documents and tables, but never really connects to the organisation's whole working context.
coda.summary: Genuinely inventive in joining documents to data, but not broad or deep enough to run an organisation.

faq.a4: Files you save to the workspace live in the UniWork workspace under your organization's permissions; files stored on your computer stay on your computer. When you use AI, the content to work on is sent to the model provider: through UniWork for tools that run under your organization's plan, or straight from your computer if you use your own API key.
faq.q5: Do I need a separate account for Office?
faq.a5: No. You sign in with your UniWork account, with the same permissions and workspaces as on the web.
faq.q6: How do I open a file from UniWork on the web?
faq.a6: In Documents, choose Open in app on the file you need, or press Open UniWork Office to just launch the app. If it isn't installed, UniWork walks you through the download.
